scope: X7 post-hoc warm/cold target diagnosis from previously accepted saved predictions and per-user X5 diagnostic metadata only.
not_experiment_preregistration: The original experiments and prior full/warm/cold canonical summaries have already been inspected; this plan fixes the additional six-population accuracy/stability computation before running it.

populations.warm: target_train_count >= 1 in accepted X5 diagnostic metadata
populations.affected: At least two distinct raw histories among the five fixed permutations, before LBSP canonicalization; canonical history excluded
populations.warm_affected: Intersection of warm and the shared affected mask
populations.cold_affected: Intersection of cold and the shared affected mask

accuracy.rank_convention: Unchanged saved strict-greater target rank. Top10 list membership may differ at tied scores; neither is silently replaced by the other.

stability.overlap10: Within each user, mean Top10 set-intersection size/10 over all ten unordered pairs of five outputs; then equal-user mean
stability.hitflip: Fraction of users having both saved-rank<=10 and saved-rank>10 across the five outputs; not pairwise flip mean

aggregation.ci95: Unadjusted mean +/- 4.302652729749464 * sample_sd / sqrt(3), df2, no truncation
aggregation.paired_effect: LBSP minus same-seed Control before aggregating the three differences
aggregation.analytic_baselines: Population-specific mean of accepted per-user Random/Popularity expectations; no training-seed SD or CI
aggregation.empty_population: Retain n=0 and blank numerical estimates; do not impute zeros

validation: All saved inputs match accepted C source-manifest SHA256 seals
Identical sample/user/target identities across X5 metadata, labels, methods, seeds and all six views
Affected mask recomputed from five raw sequence hashes and fixed across seeds/methods
Canonical ranks match the saved X5 rank columns
All full/affected accuracy/stability values reconcile with accepted C per-seed outputs
All full/warm/cold canonical metrics reconcile with accepted X5 per-seed summaries
Weighted warm+cold metrics reconstruct full results; weighted warm_affected+cold_affected reconstruct affected results
Population partitions, metric ranges, nonempty Top10 uniqueness and candidate/rank bounds
interpretation: Keep full-panel results primary; warm/cold results are additional diagnostics
Zero positive training-interaction count does not imply an untrained embedding under full-item cross-entropy
Conditioning on warm targets does not prove a causal cold-target explanation or guarantee favorable LBSP accuracy
Do not tune hyperparameters or discard unfavorable seeds/subsets from these results
With three fixed seeds the t intervals are descriptive and imprecise; no equivalence or general superiority claim
